details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should be improved?
Choices:
A) The clarify → plan → implement pipeline workflows (`clarify.yml`, `plan.yml`, `implement.yml`)
B) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_*` helpers)
C) The orchestrator poller and judges (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
D) Documentation only (README, `docs/`)
E) Other: name the file, workflow or feature in your answer (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What kind of improvement is wanted?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure: give a run link, issue or error text (RECOMMENDED)
B) Performance or cost (runtime, API calls, model spend)
C) Reliability or robustness (fewer stalls, retries, flaky paths)
D) Readability or refactoring with no change in behaviour
E) A new feature: describe the desired behaviour
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) The answers to Q1 and Q2 include a concrete, testable acceptance criterion (RECOMMENDED)
B) A named failing test or workflow run passes afterwards
C) No defined criterion; close this issue and file a specific one instead
